audit.whatIsWrong: Chart said Skill at Levels 4-5 and Level 6 and Riven at 2+ items. Packet chart is Riven 4-5, Riven 6, Vayne at 2+ items, and the prose (whys[6], spikes[3], late) already says Vayne owns every duel past two items.
audit.why: 55.76% winRate over 2213 games with a hard late-game fall-off; the 2+ items row contradicted its own why-text on both layers.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 -> Riven, Level 6 -> Riven, 2+ items -> Vayne, proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Lvl 2-3 W all-in, Lvl 6 Blade of the Exile, 1st item, late Silver Bolts. Ordering matches the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] said the Q chain lands 'while she's grounded' — Riven has no grounding in her kit; Ki Burst is a stun. whys[4] and spikes[1] called Wind Slash an execute; Riven's R text describes a powerful ranged attack (projectile), not a threshold execute.
audit.why: ownerKit: W = stun (hardCC), R = Wind Slash flagged projectile with no execute flag. Asserting a ground and an execute invents two mechanics a player would plan around.
audit.corrected: Ki Burst stuns (11/10/9/8/7s); Wind Slash is a ranged projectile finisher usable once per R. Vayne's Condemn (20/18/16/14/12s) is projectile, knockback and terrain-stun — the real reason to check wall proximity before dashing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere; Condemn was tracked by name only, never by duration.
audit.why: Condemn is 20s at rank 1 — the longest punishable window in the lane and the cue for every commit.
audit.corrected: phases[3].why now names the 20s Condemn window as the trade trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing-interactions file flags two applicable items never stated: both sides carry displacement (Broken Wings third cast vs Condemn), and Vayne's combo opens with an auto-attack reset (Tumble) whose wind-up is the tell.
audit.why: Whoever lands displacement first owns the trade; reacting to the Tumble wind-up rather than the cast is the difference between eating the trade and dodging it.
audit.corrected: Folded into spikes[0] and phases[3].why sequencing.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Condemn's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: You own this window: Condemn is a 20s cooldown at rank 1, so step in the moment she spends it and bank a trade every single time.

edits.before: W online at 2 gives you your first real all-in threat — E in, W-stun her before she Tumbles away, then chain all three Q casts while she's grounded.
edits.after: W online at 2 gives you your first real all-in threat — E in, W-stun her (11s at rank 1) as she winds up Tumble, then chain all three Q casts while she is stunned.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile extends your melee range and adds the Wind Slash execute — combo her to half HP and Wind Slash finishes her before Silver Bolts can proc a third time.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile extends your melee range and adds Wind Slash, a one-use ranged projectile — combo her low, then fire it as she Tumbles out, before Silver Bolts procs a third time.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile extends your melee reach past her Tumble distance and Wind Slash executes her before she can proc three Silver Bolts — your deadliest all-in window.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile extends your reach past her 300-range Tumble and Wind Slash catches her as she flees — your deadliest all-in window, so spend the 120s R on it.
